name: Dominik Szoboszlai

career_stints.note: All-competitions totals across two seasons before his January 2021 move to RB Leipzig.
All-competitions totals across two and a half seasons before his July 2023 move to Liverpool (Liverpool paid his release clause, ~€70m).

All-competitions, 2025/26 -- his most productive Liverpool season to date; voted Liverpool Men's Player of the Season. He was the club's second-top scorer (13, behind only Hugo Ekitike) and leading assist-maker (12). Premier League-only split: 36 appearances (all starts), 3233 minutes, 6 goals, 7 assists, including a joint-league-high 4 goals from outside the box and the most successful crosses (69) in the competition. Joined Liverpool July 2023; a full multi-season cumulative Liverpool total (2023/24 through 2025/26) was not itemized here because cross-source aggregation figures conflicted (one snippet suggested a much lower '5 goals, 5 assists' for 2025/26 that contradicts the more detailed and internally consistent Player-of-the-Season sourcing used above) -- the single most recent, best-corroborated season is used instead of a guessed multi-season sum. positions_played shares are a qualitative estimate based on his known primary central-midfield role plus reported use as an emergency right-back and advanced attacking outlet, not a source-verified minutes split.

notes: shots_per90 and xg_per90 (non-penalty) are 2025/26 Premier League figures sourced via search snippets referencing xgstat.com/FootyStats-style aggregation (71 shots in 36 matches, 32.39% shooting accuracy, 0.23 npxG/90); the underlying detailed pages were not independently confirmed by direct fetch.
pass_accuracy_pct, progressive_passes_per90, touches_per90, duels_won_pct: no reliable season-specific number found -- left null rather than guessed.

There is a genuine cross-source conflict on his 2025/26 goal/assist totals (13G/12A all-comp per a detailed Player-of-the-Season retrospective vs. an unsupported '5G/5A' figure from a separate search snippet with no context). The higher, more detailed figure was used and the discrepancy flagged rather than silently resolved.
Sources: thisisanfield.com (Player of the Season award), premierleague.com, bundesliga.com, redbull.com, transfermarkt.us, wikipedia.org (career cross-check only) -- via web search 2026-08-10.
